name: Investor Sentiment & Relationship Health
question: Do the investors who own this company understand it, trust management, and hold for the stated thesis — or is the register churning, hostile, or promotional?

signals.description: Tone and consistency of coverage in financial press
Activist involvement, proxy fights, public letters

recipe.query_template: {company} activist investor OR proxy fight OR open letter

signals.description: Institutional buying/selling reported in media; 13F coverage

recipe.query_template: {company} institutional investors 13F OR 13D OR 13G buying OR selling

signals.description: Short-seller reports published against the company; personal-site category for research blogs
Guidance credibility: history of raised/met vs cut/missed guidance

recipe.query_template: {company} guidance raised OR met OR cut OR missed across the past 8 quarters of earnings coverage

signals.description: IR conduct: responsiveness, restatements of KPIs, canceled calls

recipe.query_template: {company} investor relations restatement OR canceled earnings call OR KPI change

signals.description: Dividend/buyback consistency vs cuts and surprises

recipe.query_template: {company} dividend cut OR suspended OR buyback OR special dividend

grade_anchors.A: Stable, informed base; management guidance historically reliable; no live activist/short campaigns; independent coverage tone matches company narrative.
grade_anchors.C: Mixed: churning narrative, guidance credibility questioned at least once in 4 quarters, or one unresolved activist/short thesis with partial merit.
grade_anchors.F: Open hostility: credible short reports unanswered, serial guidance misses reframed as beats, mass institutional exit, or evidence of coordinated promotion.

false_signals.description: Abnormal press-release volume in the 60 days before a share offering, lockup expiry, or reported insider sales. Compare PR frequency (news search, company domain) across trailing windows; cross-reference offering/insider news.

recipe.query_template: {company} share offering OR secondary offering OR lockup expiry OR insider selling

false_signals.description: Same bullish narrative appearing near-simultaneously across low-authority sites. Search-result clustering by publish date + domain-authority heuristics.

recipe.query_template: {company} stock undervalued OR massive upside OR next big

false_signals.description: Guidance walked down mid-quarter then "beaten." Agent run comparing guidance-change news vs earnings-result news per quarter.

recipe.query_template: {company} lowered OR walked down guidance mid-quarter then beat earnings, per quarter

evidence_policy.notes: No social-media firehose in v1 (Exa removed the tweet category); investor sentiment is inferred from press and published research coverage only — disclose this gap.
